steps.sh: echo "--- tmux"; tmux -L unsent-072 display -p -t $SESS "alt=#{alternate_on} dead=#{pane_dead}";echo "--- ps"; ps -o pid,ppid,stat,command -ax | grep -E "bin/agy|bin/unsent" | grep -v grep;echo "--- open under the scratch home"; P=$(pgrep -f "$RIG/bin/agy" | head -1); lsof -p "$P" 2>/dev/null | grep -F "$RIG/home" | awk '{print $4, $NF}' | sed "s|$RIG|RIG|";echo "--- agent folder"; find "$RIG/home/.gemini/antigravity-cli" -maxdepth 1 -type f | while read f; do echo "$(stat -f "%z" "$f") $f"; done | sed "s|$RIG|RIG|";echo "--- conversations"; ls -la "$RIG/home/.gemini/antigravity-cli/conversations" 2>/dev/null | tail -n +2;echo "--- last_conversations.json"; cat "$RIG/home/.gemini/antigravity-cli/cache/last_conversations.json" 2>/dev/null;echo; echo "--- history.jsonl"; cat "$RIG/home/.gemini/antigravity-cli/history.jsonl" 2>/dev/null;echo "--- update_status.json"; cat "$RIG/home/.gemini/antigravity-cli/updater/update_status.json" 2>/dev/null; echo;echo "--- agy binary"; shasum -a 256 "$RIG/agy/antigravity";
